<thought>Using the functional group list, I will search for templates that break a halide and form a secondary or tertiary amine, which corresponds to an SN2 substitution.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["secondary amines", "tertiary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
